summary: Very full about page (14 sections, 12,000 px): a photo card with an overlaid navy panel, an orange metrics band, mission and "old model vs our way" blocks, a 18-person leadership grid, a founder message and values. Needs 18 leader names with titles (about 13 photos), five figures, a founder portrait and a values list.
